inputs.architectureDecision: r27d only supplies x86-64 Linux host executables. The emulated amd64 SwiftPM run stopped at the package manifest. The native arm64 route uses pinned arm64 Swift and its bundled LLVM tools with the same official r27d target headers, libraries, and Clang resource inputs. A worker needing to execute r27d's host binaries should use native x86-64 Linux.

setup.observerCorrection: The exact Linux machine field was printed as X86-64. The first host checker compared case-sensitively to x86-64. Corrected against terminal output without repeating setup.
evidence: setup-android-sdk.sh: success: ndk-sysroot linked to Android NDK at /inputs/android-ndk-r27d/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt
setup.method: Unpack checksum-verified archives offline into a labelled case-sensitive Docker volume. Use tar --no-same-owner with capabilities dropped. Run the SDK's own setup script with ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/inputs/android-ndk-r27d and remove the script directory before build mounts. Confirm the two case-distinct NDK headers, sysroot symlink, arm64 Swift runtime object, and exact NDK linker.

earlierAttempts.diagnosis: The native host evaluated the manifest and launched Android compilation. SwiftPM selected swift-x86_64 resources when passed a bundle ID plus --triple. The Android frontend failed to find its arm64 Swift module. Select the exact SDK by target triple alone, as the pinned Mixer source does.
